tagline: Primus is the front door. The rest of the house is frogs, oysters, whales, and a Lennon.
intro:
Les Claypool has spent four decades making bass the lead vocal — first with **Primus**, then through a swamp of side projects that share DNA without repeating the joke. This map treats the whole universe as one catalog: start at *Seas of Cheese* (or the rawer *Frizzle Fry*), then hop by taste instead of chronology.

Covers are placeholder marks. Use the listen links and go play the actual records.

startAlbums.label: Sailing the Seas of Cheese
startAlbums.hint: The usual door: Jerry, Tommy, and the cartoon-metal breakthrough.

startAlbums.label: Frizzle Fry
startAlbums.hint: The alt door: dirtier, earlier, still fully formed.

lanes.label: Funk-metal
lanes.blurb: Slap, grit, and cartoon menace — the Primus lane most people came for.

lanes.label: Swamp-psych
lanes.blurb: Holy Mackerel and the solo records: Rancho Relaxo diaries, less thrash, more mud.

lanes.label: Frogs
lanes.blurb: The Fearless Flying Frog Brigade — jam-band Claypool with Whamola and cover-band courage.

lanes.label: Delirium prog
lanes.blurb: Sean Lennon plus Claypool: space-station psych, concept records, sacred-cow covers.

lanes.label: Experimental
lanes.blurb: C2B3, guest-heavy Primus, leftover soundtracks — the rooms without a chorus.

lanes.label: Twang
lanes.blurb: Duo de Twang: overalls, covers, and the same songs with the distortion peeled off.

footerBlurb: Unofficial Claypool-universe field guide covering Primus and the side quests. Not affiliated with Primus, Prawn Song, or ATO.
